name: speakmanai-local
description: Connects the Claude app to SPEAKMAN.AI running on this computer.
long_description: A small bridge between the Claude app and the SPEAKMAN.AI program on your computer (SpeakmanAI.exe). It adds no tools of its own: it passes each request to the local server and returns the answer. Start SpeakmanAI.exe first. If the setup page shows a port other than 8000, set it under this extension's settings.

port.title: SpeakmanAI port
port.description: The port shown on the SpeakmanAI setup page. It is 8000 unless you changed it.
